files.description: Product returns in March (80 rows): return_id (whole number), quantity (whole number), refund (two decimals). Same columns as returns_april.csv.
Product returns in April: the header row (return_id, quantity, refund, as in returns_march.csv) and no data rows, because nothing was returned in April.

task_text: Combine the March and April returns into one table and give summary statistics of the refund amounts: count, mean, standard deviation, minimum, the three quartiles and maximum. `result` should be a Series indexed by the statistic names.
intended_computation: April has no rows, so the statistics are those of the 80 March refunds: count 80, mean, sample standard deviation (n - 1), minimum, 25%/50%/75% percentiles with linear interpolation, maximum.

acceptable_variants.notes: statistic labels may be spelled differently (e.g. 'std', '50%' or 'median'); values to 6 significant digits; the standard deviation may be the sample (n - 1) or the population (n) version; the quartiles may follow any standard quantile definition (linear, lower, higher, nearest, midpoint)

predicted_direction.reason: After concat with the header-only April table, refund stays numeric on 2.x and describe() gives the numeric summary; on 3.x the column becomes text-like and describe() returns count/unique/top/freq.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row R05; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
